utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep — I’m ready to help check who needs what.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — could you help check who needs what and let me know if sign-ins or sorting still need coverage?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll check sign-ins and sorting now, and tell you what still needs coverage.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, thanks for checking. I’m still a bit behind, but I’ll send over any other names if they come to me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Noah — that helps a lot. If you think of any volunteers, just send them my way and I’ll add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll do that, and sorry if I’m a little slow to catch up. I’ll send you any names I remember.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely—I’ll keep pickup flexible and wait for the final time. Just send it over when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Faye — I’ll send the exact time and place as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — just keep me posted, and I’ll work around it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll bring my toolbox and look for tape and screws too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thank you — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep checking with Mrs. Patel, 3B, and a few others so we don’t miss anyone.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks — let me know if there’s anything else you still need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the repair drive setup yet, but I’m still watching for the exact spot and time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re starting Saturday morning at the community shed, and that’s where folks should drop things off first. If you want, I can also help you get oriented when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — Saturday morning at the community shed is the drop-off spot, and I’ll keep that noted. If anything changes, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep — I’ll check in after my errands and see what still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. I’m still piecing it together from the block chatter, so just let me know what’s still needed when you check in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll ask around on my errands and let you know what I find out about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks — send over the list, and I’ll check the garage for anything useful. I’ll do my best not to forget this time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren — I’ll send the list over, and if you find anything useful in the garage, just set it aside and let me know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’ll dig through the garage and set anything useful aside. Just nudge me if I go quiet, will you?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, please—send me the details. I’d like to take a look.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure thing—I’ll send over the details right now, and I can point out what’s still needed too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’d appreciate that. I’ll look it over and see where I can help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s coming along nicely, and we’re still glad to take any extra tools or supplies. If you swing by later, I’ll add them right to the pile.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — tape, screws, and a couple flashlights are still the big ones. I’ll swing by later and add anything else I can find.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be fantastic, Cleo — tape, screws, and flashlights are exactly the kind of things we need. I’ll keep an eye out and add anything else that comes in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Kira — I’ll keep checking in on the repair drive, and if you hear anything while you’re out, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay — just to confirm, you’ll keep checking in on it, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes — I’ll keep checking in on the repair drive and let folks know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Pia — I’m still waiting on the final time, but if you can stay flexible with pickup, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can stay flexible, but I still need the final time and a clear drop-off spot so I can plan my part.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I hear you — I’m waiting on the final time too, but I’ll send it as soon as I get it, along with the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rey — I can sort the tools and check the porch light. Where should I start?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Start with the porch light, and if you can swing it, check on tape and screws too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll check the porch light first, then grab the tape and screws.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep — I’ll check in after my errands and ask around to see what still needs help with.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. Let me know what you hear after your errands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll ask around and let you know what I find after I’m done with errands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: The turnout’s still looking pretty good, Faye—people have already dropped off some tools and a few supplies. If you hear of any extras, send them my way and I’ll add them to the pile.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great to hear—I’ll keep an eye out for anything extra and send it your way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Faye—that’d be a big help. I’ll keep stacking everything neatly and let you know if we still need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still hearing bits and pieces, but it sounds like hands, tools, and a few supplies would help most.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that sounds about right — I don’t think anything’s changed on my end. I’m sorry I’m a bit behind, but I can help spread the word if needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Noah — that’d help a lot. I’m still piecing it together, so spreading the word is exactly what we need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what’s left on the list, and where do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks for jumping in — I’m still checking the list, but if you can bring any usable tools or supplies, that’d help a lot. I’ll keep asking around too and let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll bring whatever tools I can find and check in once I’m there. Just tell me where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the exact Saturday time and a quick note on shed access for unloading.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll check on the Saturday time and shed access, then send you a quick update.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — once you have that, I can plan around it and be there ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what time and place the repair drive is, and what you still need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s at 10 by the community hall, and if you can bring tape and gloves, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — 10 at the community hall, and I’ll bring tape and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — we’re at the community shed Saturday morning, and folks should drop repairs there first. I can also bring a few extra tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Gus — I’ll keep spreading the word about the shed on Saturday morning. If you think of anyone else who should know, send me their names and I’ll reach out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate it. I’ll think of a few more folks and send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — I’m still waiting on the final time for the repair drive, but I’ll send it over as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Uli — just send the time when you have it, and I’ll be there ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate that, Sam — it really helps.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can take the supply list and help sort materials, and I can cover a sign-in shift too if that still helps.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That helps a lot, Mara—please take the supply list and sort the materials, and if you can, cover a sign-in shift too. Let’s keep it organized and decide the meeting spot next.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll take the supply list, sort the materials, and cover the sign-in shift. Where should we meet?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the setup yet, but I’m keeping an eye out for the exact spot and time. If you need a drop-off location, I can check the closest one to Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Opal — just send me the drop-off spot and time when you find it. I can bring tape, screws, and flashlights.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Kira — we still need a few volunteers to sort donated materials, manage sign-ins, and keep the supply list updated.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, that’s still the same list of help needed, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, that’s still the list — sorting donated materials, managing sign-ins, and keeping the supply list updated. If you’d like, I can assign you one of those now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks — send me the list and I’ll check the garage for anything useful. I’ll do my best not to forget this time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — we’re mostly short on tape, screws, and a few basic tools. If you find any of those in the garage, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, got it — tape, screws, and basic tools. I’ll check the garage and bring over whatever I can find.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
